visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an outdoor theme park setting on a sunny day. A young boy wearing a black traditional robe with a large red '祭' (festival) character on the back is standing on a stone-paved path. In the background, Donald Duck in his classic blue sailor outfit is interacting with other park guests. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, casting clear shadows on the ground. (2) Daisy Duck, dressed in a vibrant pink dress with yellow floral accents and a purple bow, approaches the boy. She gently takes his hand, looking down at him. A blurred hand from an unidentified person in the crowd attempts to reach out and touch Daisy's costume, prompting her to pull back and gesture defensively with her gloved hands. (3) Daisy Duck then poses with the boy for a commemorative photo, placing her arm around his shoulder. Later, a teenage girl with her hair in a ponytail and wearing a black sailor-style school shirt approaches Daisy with an autograph book. The girl smiles while holding a pen and looking at the character. (4) As Daisy prepares to sign the book, another attempt by a guest to touch her occurs. Daisy reacts by pointing to her head and making a 'No' gesture, accompanied by a visual fire emoji overlay. She eventually completes the signature and poses for a final photo with the girl, holding the signed book. The background includes trees, historical-style buildings, and other park visitors.
